Reserve Your Tent Explore Our Tents
Authentic Luxury Desert Camp Discover the Heart of the Moroccan Sahara
There is nothing quite like waking up in the Sahara. The light is different here. The silence has a texture. And the dunes — rising 150 metres above the desert floor at Erg Chebbi — shift colour from pale gold to deep amber to violet as the day moves.
Sahara Dunes Camp is a small, family-run luxury camp built at the edge of those dunes, outside Merzouga in southern Morocco. We offer a handful of handcrafted Berber tents — each with a real bed, a private hot shower, and décor that reflects the heritage of the region. Every stay is all-inclusive: dinner, breakfast, camel or 4×4 transfer, campfire music, and the kind of hospitality that only a local-run camp can offer.
We keep the camp intentionally small. Because the Sahara deserves your full attention — and so do you.

Our Story
Family-Run Luxury in the Heart of the Sahara
Welcome to Sahara Dunes Camp, where authentic Berber hospitality meets luxury desert comfort. Founded by the Berber family, our camp in Merzouga offers an intimate, personalized experience under the stars of Erg Chebbi.
Who We Are A Family Camp in the Heart of Erg Chebbi
We are a small, family-run camp settled at the edge of the Erg Chebbi dunes, just outside Merzouga in southern Morocco. Everything here — from the way the tents are furnished to the meals we serve each evening — reflects the Berber heritage of the families who built and run this camp.
Erg Chebbi is one of the most spectacular landscapes in the Sahara. The dunes rise to over 150 metres, shift colour from pale gold at noon to deep amber at sunset, and fall completely silent after dark. We have made our home here so that you can experience all of that — closely, quietly, and without the noise of mass tourism.
Our camp is intentionally small. We keep the number of tents limited so that every guest receives genuine attention, real hospitality, and a stay that feels personal rather than packaged.
How We Think Comfort and Authenticity Are Not Opposites
There is a version of desert tourism that gives you a canvas tent, a thin mattress, and calls it an adventure. That is not what we do.
There is another version that wraps the desert in so much luxury that you could be anywhere in the world. That is not what we do either.
Sahara Dunes Camp sits in the space between. Every tent is genuinely furnished with handwoven Moroccan rugs, carved lanterns, and traditional textiles — because these things are beautiful and because they are honest to where you are. And every tent also has a real bed with quality linens, a private hot shower, electricity, and free Wi-Fi — because comfort is not a compromise, it is part of the experience.
We believe the best desert stay is one where nothing pulls you out of the moment. Where you fall asleep to the silence of the dunes and wake up to a sky still full of stars — and where the tea is already warm when you step outside.
The People Behind the Camp Guided by Locals. Shaped by Experience.
Every person who works at Sahara Dunes Camp is from the region. Our guides grew up reading the dunes the way others read maps. Our kitchen team cooks the same tagines and harira their grandmothers made. Our camp staff speak the language of Berber hospitality — attentive, warm, and never intrusive.
When you arrive at our camp — whether by camel at sunset or by 4×4 in the early evening — you are not greeted by a uniform. You are welcomed by a person who genuinely wants your time in the Sahara to be extraordinary.
That is the difference a local-run camp makes. And it is a difference you feel from the first cup of mint tea.
Our Values
What Guides Everything We Do
At Sahara Dunes Camp, we believe true luxury is rooted in responsibility. Every decision we make is guided by a deep respect for the Sahara s fragile ecosystem, the rich Berber heritage, and the local community that calls this desert home.
Authenticity
We share real Berber culture, not staged performances. Our hospitality is genuine, rooted in generations of desert living, ensuring every guest connects with the true soul of the Sahara.
Sustainability
We protect the fragile desert ecosystem for future generations. Our camp operates with solar power, strict water conservation measures, and comprehensive waste reduction practices.
Community
We prioritize employing local guides and supporting artisans. Our goal is to ensure tourism directly benefits the families of Tessardmin, Hassilbid and Rissani, preserving local traditions while creating economic opportunity.
The Sahara Is Waiting
Ready to Experience It?
Whether you are planning a solo escape, a trip for two, or an adventure with a group — Sahara Dunes Camp has a tent for you. Browse our tents or reach out directly and we will help you put together the perfect desert stay.
View Our Tents Contact Us

Overview of Triple Separate Desert Tent
The Triple Separate Desert Tent is built for groups who want to experience the Sahara together without sacrificing personal comfort. At 40 m², it is one of our most spacious tents — thoughtfully arranged so three guests can move freely, gather, and unwind in a beautifully decorated Berber interior.
Each of the three single beds is positioned in its own private corner with an individual reading lamp, plush linens, and personal storage space. A central seating area with traditional cushions and lanterns brings everyone together for mint tea, cards, and conversation under the stars.
Ideal for: Close friends, work colleagues on a retreat, or three solo travellers who want the company of shared adventure without compromising personal comfort.
Everything Included for All Three Guests Tent Services
Spacious 40 m² Tent – Separate sleeping zones and a shared central lounge area.
Shared En-Suite Bathroom – Inside the tent with hot shower for all guests.
3 Beds & Luxury Linens – Three separate single beds with premium cotton bedding.
Dinner & Breakfast – Authentic Moroccan cuisine for all 3 guests, daily.
Bottled Water Provided – Complimentary fresh water throughout the stay.
Electricity & Outlets – Multiple sockets for charging all devices.
Camel or 4×4 Transfer – Complimentary sunset transfer for all guests on direct bookings.
Campfire & Berber Music – Nightly drum circles for the whole group.

24/7 Attentive Staff – Warm, discreet service available at any hour.
